termos.title: Terms of Use
termos.lead: These Terms govern the use of the JMD Transfer website and transfer requests. By submitting a request, you confirm that you have read and agree to this document.
termos.s1Body: JMD Transfer provides executive mobility services (point to point, hourly hire, and concierge), with fare agreed during support. The website lets you request time slots and start operational contact.
termos.s2Body: When you submit the form, the time slot may be held for a limited period until JMD confirms. A hold does not finalize the service without confirmation and fare alignment on WhatsApp.
termos.s3Body: We do not show a final price on the public form. The fare is negotiated and confirmed on WhatsApp. Any rate-card values are internal operational references only.
termos.s4Body: Provide accurate details (name, phone, email, and addresses). Arrive on time, communicate changes in advance, and use the request code when contacting support.
termos.s5Body: Cancellations and changes to time/place must be communicated via WhatsApp. Unconfirmed holds may expire automatically. Specific cancellation terms may be aligned when the service is confirmed.
termos.s6Body: Unlawful use of the service is prohibited. JMD may refuse or interrupt services that compromise the safety of staff, vehicles, or third parties.
termos.s7Body: The website and WhatsApp channel are request and support tools. Traffic, weather, road restrictions, or force majeure may affect timing; we will keep you informed transparently.
termos.s8Body: For questions about these Terms or a request, use the official WhatsApp/email on the website and include the request code when available.

privacidade.title: Privacy Policy
privacidade.lead: This Policy explains how JMD Transfer processes personal data under Brazil’s LGPD (Law No. 13,709/2018) for the website and service requests.
privacidade.s1Body: JMD Transfer is responsible for personal data collected through the website and support channels linked to transfer requests.
privacidade.s2Body: We may collect full name, phone/WhatsApp, email, origin/destination/stop addresses, service/vehicle preferences, requested date/time, request code, and support messages.
privacidade.s3Body: Data is used to process the request, hold the slot, confirm the service, agree the fare, provide support, meet legal obligations, and operate safely.
privacidade.s4Body: We process data for pre-contractual steps and service performance, to respond to data-subject requests, and to meet legal/regulatory duties when applicable.
privacidade.s5Body: Data may be shared with drivers/operators involved in the ride and with infrastructure providers (hosting, database, messaging), only as needed to deliver the service.
privacidade.s6Body: We keep data for as long as needed for the request, operational history, and legal obligations. We apply reasonable technical and organizational safeguards.
privacidade.s7Body: You may request access, correction, anonymization, portability, or deletion of your data, and information about processing, via the official website channels. We will respond under the LGPD.
